name: confluence-live-sync
description: Keeps a Confluence page in sync with a local project folder whose name matches a Jira issue's summary -- generic/reusable version of the folder-name-to-Jira-issue matching pattern, config-driven (no hardcoded project/template), bidirectional (local files merge into the page; the page mirrors back into a local file), and watchable in the background via a Windows Scheduled Task running headless Claude Code.
